==============================

App name: RF-Scope
Package: com.rfscope.app
Version: 0.6.0 (versionCode 6)
Build type: debug (installable; Android Debug certificate)
Min SDK: 29 (Android 10)
Target/compile SDK: 34 (Android 14)
Built at: 2026-11-08 (Asia/Shanghai)

Changes in 0.6.0:
- Live TinySA scan loop with LIVE/STOP and preset ranges.
- 240-frame spectrum waterfall.
- Peak-level-driven rising audio tone.
- RSRP/RSRQ/SINR 3-bar icons with requested thresholds.
- Event-driven SignalStrength callbacks with polling fallback.
- 120-second signal trend window with missing samples broken.
- WiFi channel charts use downward-opening parabolas.
- WiFi row selection highlights the row and matching channel curve.
- USB_DEVICE_ATTACHED filter for VID 0x0483 / PID 0x5740.

Notes:
- Debug certificate; not suitable for Play Store publishing.
- TinySA scanrange currently selected by presets 400-500M / 430-440M / 2.4-2.5G.
